title: Completed strict henselization is flat over the base
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring with maximal ideal n, let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of its residue field, and let T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r be its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical ring map A\to T is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
